vendor_api.note: Endpoint and param shape confirmed from results/rebuild_stage1/collect_massive_data_v2.py (T2-fixed, validated trades collector - read for reference only, not executed) and data/collection_scripts/collect_massive_data.py (read-only reference for the quotes endpoint symmetry). archive_schema.note: File-level (per-folder trades.parquet/quotes.parquet) archive schema, confirmed via a full-corpus parquet_schema() scan (research/phase_1c/derive_archive_schema.py). This is the target for staged fetch alignment and for T6 repair sibling files. The filtered_trades/filtered_quotes DB tables further drop conditions/indicators (LIST-typed columns) on ingest per src/data/ingest.py's PARQUET_LIST_INTERNAL_NAMES design - unchanged, unrelated to this phase.

hard_boundary.note: The ~1,540-folder trades-only quote-file gap (no quotes.parquet on disk, uncharacterized mechanism, Phase 4 owns it) is never touched by this phase. Heal side rule: trades_ingested=TRUE & quotes_ingested=TRUE events heal trades+quotes; trades_ingested=TRUE & quotes_ingested=FALSE events heal trades only.
